note.zh-TW: 教材稱股東權益總額（舊稱）；模板沒有這一列。
note.en: The course says total shareholders’ equity, an older term; the template has no such line.

definition.zh-TW: 股本、資本公積、保留盈餘等權益項目的合計。計算權益報酬率時它是分母，計算長期資金占固定資產比率時它是分子的一部分。
definition.en: The sum of share capital, capital surplus, retained earnings and the other equity items. The site uses it as an input to return on equity and the long-term funds to property, plant and equipment ratio.
